provenance.prompt: High-fidelity DELTA mobile UI design review board. Landscape 3:2 large canvas with SIX readable portrait Android screens arranged in a 3-column by 2-row grid, generous outer spacing, small numbered labels under each. Crisp modern Geist-like typography, practical 48dp controls. All screens consistent: neutral near-black #090909, charcoal glass surfaces, off-white text, restrained pearl buttons, NO blue background, NO bottom tab bar, no horizontal header/footer borders. Delta identity is a completely ROUND glossy luminous ORB: layered flowing pearl pink magenta violet lobes, upper-left white sheen, thin bright rim and shadowed lower edge, subtle bloom. NO star/sparkle/Gemini logo, no triangle, no surrounding rings. Use a tiny orb beside Delta name and large orb only appropriate on welcome/voice screens. Orb palette is proposed mobile adaptation. Conversation messages are Discord style unboxed shared surface with avatar, sender, time and grouped text; no speech bubbles. All content is clearly labelled sample/proposed, never fake real telemetry. Page chrome: back or menu top left, page name, appropriate action; no developer implementation jargon in product copy. Presentation title and subtitle 'Design proposal • Sample content'. Each screen has unique meaningful content, not a repeated generic list.  BOARD 01: 'Conversations & navigation'. Screen 1 label H01 Welcome: menu Delta On-device dropdown header; large authentic glossy orb, 'What’s on your mind?', Plan my day and Explore an idea chips, large rounded composer plus Message Delta mic. Screen 2 H02 Full-screen hub: full width opaque hub (no sliver of chat), Delta Conversations header X close; search; New conversation; vertical channels General Work Ideas with Work selected, recent session rows Website refresh and Weekend plans with previews/time; secondary destinations Agent, Connections, Activity, Settings, Help. Screen 3 H03 Channel sessions: Work channel heading, search, pinned Website refresh and recent Launch checklist, New session action, no cards on each row. Screen 4 H04 Conversation: hamburger Work / Website refresh header, Traves and Delta ORB avatars, sender times, unboxed grouped conversation about simplifying navigation, plus/message/mic composer bottom. Screen 5 H05 Search: search 'navigation', segmented Sessions / Messages, grouped matching session title and message excerpts with #Work context, clear search and back. Screen 6 H06 Session actions: underlying conversation dimmed behind bottom sheet title Website refresh, Rename, Move to channel, Pin, Export, Delete, Cancel; clear danger treatment only Delete. Bottom note 'Menu or edge swipe opens hub • X, swipe left or Back closes • Selecting a session resumes it'.
